name: Wine Connection Bistro - Tampines  One
description:
Wine Connection Group owns and operates the largest chain of wine retail shops and full-service wine-themed restaurants in Thailand and Singapore. We are the exclusive importer of over 300+ labels of wines from around the world, craft beers, glassware and related accessories, as well as selected delicatessen products.

Since its inception in 1998, Wine Connection has steadily grown the number of wine retail shops, and diversified into the full-service restaurant business by introducing the integrated retail wine shop – restaurant concept, becoming the leader in Thailand and Singapore with more than 100 outlets to date, and counting.

Our mission is to bring fresh, flavourful, and affordable dishes to Southeast Asia, driven by a passion for connecting people through great food and wine. Inspired by Mediterranean cuisine, our menu features classic favourites designed to suit a variety of tastes and pair beautifully with our exclusive wine labels. Each Bistro includes an integrated wine shop, giving guests the flexibility to enjoy our large selection of wines in-store or to take home.

At Wine Connection, we believe in creating memorable moments through quality, accessibility, and exceptional value. (Jul 2026)
